meta.name: image-to-video
meta.description: Generate videos from static images using FAL AI models — Kling V2.6 Pro for premium quality with audio, Wan V2.6 for fast generation. Handles avatar animations, product demos, and marketing clips.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态图片变成带声音的动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有商品图想快速变成演示视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn still images into dynamic videos with audio.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have product images and want quick demo videos.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据静态图片生成视频:你提供图片和动作描述,它会调用 FAL AI 模型产出视频文件,可选 Kling V2.6 Pro(支持音频)或 Wan V2.6,还能设置时长、负面提示等。
howto.when: 当你说“把这张图做成视频”“让图片动起来”等要求,或直接提供图片地址和动作描述时,就会调用该技能生成视频。

say.text: 把这张图片做成视频,动作是人物挥手微笑。
用 Kling 模型给这张图生成带音频的视频,让角色说“你好,欢迎!”
把这张头像图做成点头眨眼的动画,时长10秒。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can generate videos from static images: you provide an image and motion prompt, and it runs a FAL AI model to produce a video file, with options for Kling V2.6 Pro (supports audio) or Wan V2.6, duration, negative prompt, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to turn an image into a video, say 'make this image move', or provide an image URL/path with a motion description.

say_en.text: Make a video from this image, with the character waving and smiling.
Use Kling model to make a video with audio, character says 'Hello, welcome!'
Turn this avatar into a 10-second animation with nodding and blinking.
